intent: Add a POST /auth/login endpoint that returns a token and never trusts the client user id.
notes: Technical contract with a security constraint; gold at sentence granularity.

known_facts.statement: The API adds a POST /auth/login endpoint for authentication.
A successful call returns a token to the caller.
The user identity must be derived server-side, never trusted from the client.

assumptions.statement: A session or auth store already exists to validate credentials.

options.statement: Return either a signed token or an opaque server-side session id.

decisions.statement: Resolve the user id from the authenticated principal on the server.

open_questions.statement: Clarify how long the returned token remains valid.
